messages:
carmen: quick heads-up — after yesterday's runtime optimizer deploy we're seeing a latency/cost regression for Mistral/Mixtral in Dedicated pools. p50 p95 up ~2x for some customers. suspect kernel selection fallback spike.

devon: can you paste the flame/profile? which models and which kernel fell back? :thinking:

carmen: repro run on mistral-7b and qwen-7b using the standard loadgen. gist of perf:
```
Model       kernel_used   p50(ms)  p95(ms)  fallback_rate
mistral-7b  flash         14.3     48.9     38% -> actually SDPA for some heads
qwen-7b     triton/sdpa   12.1     34.2     5%
mixtral-8b  sdpa          16.8     65.4     42%
```
Fallback reason logs show: "flash_init_failed: head_dim %8 != 0" for lots of layers, and several "mask_alignment_mismatch: kv_offset%warp!=0" entries. Also seeing extra memcpy in KV path causing kernel slowpath.

ryan: ugh — head_dim not multiple of 8/16 is hitting our FlashAttention guard. which layer dims? Mistral often has 10/20 head dims for some variants?

carmen: exactly. mistral-7b variant has head_dim=10, mixtral has 12 in some forks. flash currently bails to SDPA when head_dim%8!=0 because our PTX kernels assume 8-aligned lanes. That worked before because we compiled alternate kernels, but the optimizer yesterday changed kernel preference order so SDPA is picked at runtime more frequently and we're not reusing cached compiled kernels.

matt: infra-bot shows the rollout: optimizer v2.4 pushed 2026-03-16 03:12 UTC; it changed "kernel_ranking" to prefer predicted latency over compatibility. That exposed the compatibility checks failing and triggering fallback more often.

infra-bot: deploy v2.4 -> all clusters. Canary hosts: r-infer-canary-23, r-infer-canary-24. No automatic rollback configured.

devon: two action items: (1) short-term mitigation: prefer SDPA for models where head_dim%8!=0 but avoid switching ranking for models that had precompiled flash kernels (2) fix KV mask alignment by introducing a safe-copy path that avoids misaligned warps.

claira: for (1) I propose adding a model-profile tag e.g., "force_sdpa_unaligned_heads":true in the model catalog so Dedicated customers don't hit regression. We can roll this per-model.

ryan: for (2) I'm seeing the mask_alignment_mismatch occurs when cache_offset%32 !=0 for some continuous streaming sessions. Quick patch idea: in the runtime, when kv_offset%warp_size != 0, pad the KV chunk with zeros on GPU (cheap) instead of copying back to host. Should be a local memcpy on GPU and then use flash kernel. That preserves throughput and avoids host roundtrips.

matt: that's doable — but watch memory overhead. We should gate the padding behind a flag "gpu_kv_pad_for_flash" and default it off until profiled.

carmen: repro steps I used (local):
```
# reproduce: run with pinned model variant and continuous streaming
python tools/loadgen.py --model mistral-7b-unaligned --batch 8 --streaming --duration 600 --profile
# collect logs
jq '.events[] | select(.msg|test("flash_init_failed|mask_alignment_mismatch"))' /tmp/infer.log
```
Environment: CUDA 12.3, driver 535, Triton 2.10, flash-attn build from our docker image (2026-03-10).

devon: can someone open a quick PR for the catalog tag + heuristic change with a test asserting that models with head_dim%8!=0 pick SDPA by default? also add an integration test for GPU-side KV pad path.

ryan: i'll take the KV pad patch, add a micro-benchmark and memory safety checks. will land behind feature flag.

claira: i'll own the catalog change and add an e2e scenario in our canary matrix to catch this class of regressions.

matt: i'll draft the rollback/duck-tape for canary so we can fast revert optimizer ranking if we see >10% p95 increase across dedicated pools.

carmen: thanks all. leaving notes in the incident board and tagging impacted customer tickets. we'll reconvene after PRs land. :thumbsup:
